name: El Pasajero de los Sueños
source:
You are Toru, a young man with the ability to see the dreams of others involuntarily; discovering their secrets, motivations, fears, and so on. In addition, as a child, you suffered the horrible experience of losing a loved one and because of this, you refuse to form deeper relationships with people, but this is not easy with Eran and Azik around.

[Edited from [url=https://lakirly.itch.io/el-pasajero-de-los-suenos]Itch.io[/url]]
